summary: Official Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha and Balrampur district land-record evidence was found. The current public viewer JavaScript/configuration was inspected and its anonymous hierarchy, GIS-code, extent, and exact-point map-hit routes were exercised. No safe native parcel identity plus full polygon geometry was obtained, so runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Hindi discovery queries, exact text and actual result URLs are recorded in city-10005-balrampur.json.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GET retrieved the current viewer HTML and main JavaScript. The configured API base was https://upbhunaksha.gov.in/bhunakshaserver. Anonymous POST /masterdata/levelvalue returned district 182 बलरामपुर, tehsil 00925 बलरामपुर, and 268 village entries. Urban-area Balrampur code 216218 mapped to gisCode 18200925216218; POST /MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref returned HTTP 200 JSON with xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax all 0.0. POST /MapInfo/getPlotAtXY using that GIS code and the exact WUP longitude/latitude returned {}. Nearby Balrampur Dehat code 173305 returned gisCode 18200925173305 and HTTP 200 extent with CRS EPSG:32644, but it was not treated as the city point and no geometry was retained.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200; current Angular viewer HTML identified public API base and loaded configuration.
HTTP 200; current routes identified for hierarchy, GIS-code, map extent, plot hit-test, plot lookup and WMS; only safe hierarchy/extent/hit-test routes were used.
Anonymous POST level=1 returned district 182 बलरामपुर among official Hindi district records.
Anonymous POST level=2&codes=182 returned tehsil 00925 बलरामपुर, plus Tulsipur and Utraula.
Anonymous POST level=3&codes=182,00925 returned 268 villages; urban-area Balrampur code 216218 had hasData=false and Balrampur Dehat code 173305 had hasData=true.
Anonymous POST returned HTTP 200 with all-zero extent and attribution for urban-area Balrampur.

Anonymous POST with exact WUP point [27.424560059918, 82.1756840536558] in latitude/longitude preserved in the city record, sent as x=82.1756840536558 and y=27.424560059918 per the viewer route; response {}.
Balrampur Dehat GIS code 18200925173305 returned bounded EPSG:32644 extent; this was a coverage sanity check, not a city-point substitution.
HTTP 200; official district page directs users to UP Bhulekh.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [27.424560059918, 82.1756840536558] was preserved; the zero extent and {} hit-test response are not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
The nearby Balrampur Dehat extent is outside the exact urban-area record and was not used to manufacture a parcel hit.
No full parcel polygon or safe native parcel identity was retrieved, so no sample GeoJSON is retained.
The public viewer hierarchy and DILRMP status do not establish anonymous citywide vector coverage or municipal-boundary correspondence.
Plot-detail/RoR routes were not requested because their UI purpose may return unsafe owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields.
Packet completion records research status only; it does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter.
